title: Native Triton source admission uses32-lane launch checks for every target
observation: At the actual native authoring boundary, a32-group xcore1002 or gfx938 request reaches the builder because the structural check computes32*32=1024threads. Both declared routes have64lanes, so the requested launch is2048threads and exceeds the Target maximum1024. The same group count is legal on the32-lane sm_103a route. Removing warp_size also leaves the constructor admitted. The pinned before suite reproduces three failures and one valid32-lane control; the rejecting builder fixture performs no compilation or device work.
proposed_change: Resolve the existing Triton route from the immutable emission requirements, require declared num_warps and compute block threads from the route-owned lane width before building. Refuse missing route facts rather than substituting32. Use vendor-neutral wording in the shared structural specification refusal. Add no Target table, vendor fallback, hardware limit, IR primitive or experiment policy.

verified_by.tests: 55 focused CPU contracts passed, including original before probes, Native Triton pairing, declared width and vendor-neutrality controls
verified_by.scope: Native source/launch admission; no new hardware or performance qualification

promotion_disposition: Promoted the shared native-authoring structural guard. Oversized wave64 requests now refuse before any builder call; valid32-lane requests retain their path. Old frozen Runs remain unchanged.
